generationPromptZh: 一个带封底空腔、开放锅口及两侧角形握耳的锅。它由锅底、锅壁、口沿及左右两个握耳组成。底部厚度约为主体宽度的0.14倍，连续壁围成开口空腔。宽深比约1.67，高/最大水平跨度约0.45；口沿位于围合侧壁上方，口沿与主体宽度比1.00。实测采用2种不透明颜色，锅壁以棕色为主，锅沿呈浅棕色。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.47000000000000003, "category": "pot", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount", "neck aperture ratio", "functional rim projection", "base taper", "support cross section", "functional part position"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "deckPositionRatio": 0.27, "depth": 12.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "handleThickness": 3.2, "height": 10.0, "instance": 0, "lensHeightRatio": 0.42, "lipOverhang": 0.4, "neckFraction": 0.35, "ordinal": 68571, "redesign": 0, "replanPhase": 1, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.5399999999999999, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "supportThickness": 3.2, "towerMiddleWidthFraction": 0.8150000000000001, "towerTopWidthFraction": 0.6050000000000001, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 14.0}

The floor is 0.14 body-widths thick; connected walls surround an open cavity. Width/depth is 1.67; height/horizontal-span is 0.45. The rim sits above the surrounding walls. Rim/body width is 1.00. Across 2 opaque colors, the walls is mainly brown and the rim is tan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
